title: Request: Low-Dose Naltrexone (LDN)
body:
Subject: Request to consider Low-Dose Naltrexone (LDN)

Dear Dr. {{DOCTOR_LASTNAME}},

I’m writing to ask whether a carefully monitored trial of low-dose naltrexone could be appropriate for my ME/CFS symptoms. My goals are to reduce crashes/pain and improve day-to-day function.

If reasonable, I’m open to starting at a low dose and titrating slowly while monitoring response and tolerability. I’ll continue my symptom log and follow up as you recommend. Please let me know of any contraindications or baseline labs you’d like to review first.

Thank you,
{{PATIENT_NAME}}

title: Comprehensive Workup / Rule-Outs
body:
Subject: Request for comprehensive evaluation for ME/CFS and rule-outs

Dear Dr. {{DOCTOR_LASTNAME}},

Could we review my history and ensure a thorough evaluation for ME/CFS and common mimics? I’m especially interested in ruling out endocrine, autoimmune, infectious, nutritional, and sleep-related contributors per your judgment.

I’ll bring a concise symptom timeline and prior results for your review.

Thank you,
{{PATIENT_NAME}}

title: Consider ME/CFS Diagnosis
body:
Subject: Consideration of ME/CFS diagnosis

Dear Dr. {{DOCTOR_LASTNAME}},

I’m experiencing persistent fatigue not relieved by rest, post-exertional symptom exacerbation, unrefreshing sleep, and cognitive challenges that impact daily function. Could we review whether I meet diagnostic criteria for ME/CFS and discuss next steps for management and pacing?

Sincerely,
{{PATIENT_NAME}}

title: Request: Referral to ME/CFS Center (e.g., Stanford)
body:
Subject: Referral to an ME/CFS specialty clinic

Dear Dr. {{DOCTOR_LASTNAME}},

Could we discuss a referral to a specialty clinic for ME/CFS care (for example, the Stanford ME/CFS Center or a similar program)? I’m hoping to get a comprehensive evaluation and management plan from a team that focuses on this condition.

If you agree, please let me know what documentation is needed. I can provide a concise symptom timeline, prior labs/imaging, and current medications. I’m also happy to follow any insurance/authorization steps and consider telehealth options if available.

Thank you for your guidance and support,
{{PATIENT_NAME}}
